"''Very good, Lieutenant.|Theomet Danlé and Cordé|audio=Theomet-Corde.flac|}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Theomet Danlé''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Naboo Palace Guard]] who served on board the [[J-type diplomatic barge]] of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Danlé was on board when it traveled to the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY]] so that she could vote in the [[Military Creation Act]], but was [[Death|killed]] in an explosion when the barge was destroyed in an unsuccessful [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] on Amidala's life. ==Biography== {{Quote|I shouldn't have come back.|Padme Amidala regrets the deaths caused by her return to Coruscant, including that of Danlé|audio=Padme-ShouldntHaveComeBack-AOTC.flac|}} Theomet Danlé was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Naboo Palace Guard]], a part of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces|security forces]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' In [[22 BBY]], Danlé was among the crew assigned to the [[J-type diplomatic barge]] of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], who used the vehicle to travel to the planet [[Coruscant]] in order to vote on the [[Military Creation Act]] in the [[Galactic Senate]]. Amidala's [[Head of Security]], [[Captain]] [[Gregar Typho]], feared that returning to Coruscant might put the senator in danger, so Amidala disguised herself as a [[pilot]] and flew in one of the [[N-1 starfighter]]s escorting the barge while her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]] [[Cordé]] took her place as a decoy. [[File:NabooCruiserGoBoom-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Theomet Danlé perished on Coruscant during the destruction of Padmé Amidala's J-type diplomatic barge.]] As the barge arrived above Coruscant, Danlé and a [[Security Guard]] [[trooper]]''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' approached Cordé and informed her that they were making their final approach. The barge and its escort then landed on one of Coruscant's landing platforms, and Cordé began to disembark down the ship's ramp. However, Typho's fears proved correct, for a [[bomb]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|planted]] by the [[assassin]] [[Zam Wesell]] detonated before the decoy could reach the bottom of the ramp. Danlé, Cordé, and several others were [[Death|killed]] by the explosion, although Amidala survived the attempt on her life. ==Personality and traits== Theomet Danlé had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. ==Equipment== Danlé wore a dark red version of the [[armor]] of the Palace Guard, including the [[helmet]], and had a matching [[belt]] on which the guard carried a [[S-5 Security-grade blaster/ascension gun|S-5 blaster pistol]] and a [[comlink]] with an extendable [[antenna]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:TheometBucket-LSS.png|thumb|right|300px|Theomet Danlé is depicted with a cap rather than a helmet in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''.]] Theomet Danlé was portrayed by [[Steve John Shepherd]] in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The character was credited only as "Naboo officer" in the film and in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was identified by name in the "[[Starship Fact File]]" department of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 55|fifty-fifth issue]], which was written by [[Tim Veekhoven]]{{Twitter|Sompeetalay|1037318484919771137|[[Tim Veekhoven]]|quote=#BuildtheMillenniumFalcon: Added the name of R2-H7 (damaged green and white Astromech Droid at the explosion on Coruscant) [Issue 54: Senator Amidala's Transport]|archivedate=20220327114653}} and published around [[January 20]], [[2016]]{{BMFdates|55}} The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by user "[[winstonvalleyjedi]]" as part of the [[Theomet Danlé/Legends|character's]] backstory through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]],"{{DB|character|theometdanle|Danlé, Theomet}} which ran from [[2005]] to [[2008]].{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20080321.html|text=What's the Story: The Fans Set the Facts}} In the non-canon [[2022]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Danlé is depicted wearing a [[Hat|cap]] rather than a helmet, and delivers the same dialogue as in the film; however, both the lieutenant and a [[Naboo Fighter Pilot]] accompanying them struggle to keep their footing during the scene as the J-type diplomatic barge performs a roll in [[Realspace|space]]. The pilot then rushes away to be sick, prompting Danlé to look uncomfortable before producing a bucket and following the pilot. The pilot is later seen with the bucket on their head after the barge explodes.''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Theomet Danlé}} *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|55|Starship Fact File}} {{1stID|Theomet Danlé}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Theomet Danlé }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Danlé, Theomet}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Royal Naboo Security Force officers]]
